title: Remove background music feature and photo-related sections from the anniversary site

requirements.text: Remove the background music feature from the website UI so no audio player is rendered and no audio playback logic is included in the app runtime.

quotes: remove the audio things and the photo parts

acceptanceCriteria: The MusicPlayer component is not rendered anywhere in the app.
The app no longer references or requires any audio asset paths under /assets/audio/ (directly or via config).
There are no remaining user-facing audio controls (play/pause/volume/mute) in the UI.

requirements.text: Remove all photo-related parts from the website, including the Photo Gallery section and any photo lightbox interactions.

quotes: remove the audio things and the photo parts

acceptanceCriteria: The Gallery section is not rendered in the page flow.
The navbar/scroll-spy no longer includes a Gallery entry/section id and does not track it.
No lightbox/modal is opened from gallery interactions because gallery interactions are removed.

requirements.text: Remove photo usage from the Hero section so the hero no longer displays a framed photo or any gallery-sourced image.

quotes: remove the audio things and the photo parts

acceptanceCriteria: The Hero section renders without any photo/image that was previously displayed as the framed hero photo.
The app does not reference the hero photo path (e.g., /assets/gallery/then-and-now.jpg) anymore.

requirements.text: Remove the handwritten letter image feature from the Family Messages section so the section contains only text-based messages and no letter image preview or letter lightbox.

quotes: remove the audio things and the photo parts

acceptanceCriteria: The Messages section does not render any handwritten letter image preview button.
The Messages section does not open a lightbox/modal for a handwritten letter image.
The app no longer references or requires any letter image asset paths under /assets/letters/.

requirements.text: Update the centralized anniversary configuration to remove photo/audio configuration fields and related inline instructions that are no longer applicable after removing photo/audio features.

quotes: remove the audio things and the photo parts

acceptanceCriteria: The configuration no longer contains photo gallery instructions or gallery dataset entries if they are not used by the app.
The configuration no longer contains handwritten letter image configuration if it is not used by the app.
The configuration no longer contains music/audio configuration if it is not used by the app.
The frontend builds successfully with no unused/invalid references caused by removing these config fields.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend remains a single Motoko actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Do not translate or rewrite the site’s existing content as part of this change (only remove audio/photo features/sections).
Do not introduce new sections or new features beyond removing the requested parts.
